sn35.59:1.1: la || || -anusayā samugghātam gacchantīti || || Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhave anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || Sotam || Ghānaṃ || Jivhaṃ || Kāyaṃ || Manaṃ || || Dhamme || || Manoviññāṇaṃ || Manosamphassaṃ || || Yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato anusayā samugghāṭam gacchantīti || ||
